{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially in early horizons - need 2-5% downward correction",
    "True outcomes exhibit stronger mean reversion than modeled, particularly beyond 10-day horizon",
    "Sentiment momentum amplifies forecast errors when sentiment has been trending consistently",
    "Short-term forecast lag: 1-3 day delays in price response are not captured in level forecasts",
    "When price volatility (range) has been high, both model and true values overshoot mean assumptions",
    "Sentiment turning points correlate with forecast corrections in the 3-7 day range",
    "Model underestimates price floor in declining phases by approximately 0.5-1.0 EUR"
] }
